title: System overview and authority boundaries
trace: FR-1, FR-10 to FR-15; design sections 11-15
status: Target architecture. The authoritative asset service and complete admin/policy functions are planned. External hosting is unselected.

title: Core play cycle
trace: FR-2 to FR-9, FR-16 to FR-18; design sections 2-9
status: Conceptual game loop. Optional activities do not imply real-time multiplayer or mandatory timed play throughout the loop.

title: Establish the first functional biome
status: Target workflow. Policy enforcement is planned; starter content and exact charges require approval.

title: Produce, craft and restore creature contribution
status: Target workflow. Approved recipe quantities, durations and storage-full behavior remain open.

title: Orders, milestones and island expansion
status: Target workflow. Orders supply Coins; only explicitly eligible milestones award Harmony. Thresholds and completion conditions are open.

title: Authoritative resource or Creature Card trade
status: Target only. Current resource-market transactions do not establish server asset authority or individual creature transfer. Creature price bounds use species and Quality Rank; the numeric table is pending.

title: Publish, visit and handle a delayed obstacle
status: Target workflow. A visitor command is separate from the read-only snapshot. Server fee authority and invalid-target delivery fallback remain incomplete/open.

title: Inspect and tame a wild Alpha
status: Target workflow informed by the rhythm source. Visitor inspection is required but currently blocked by the inspected click path; duplicate-safe reward must be verified.

title: River topology, scoring and persistence
status: Target workflow. Final scoring destination/formula and accepted terrain constraints are pending.

title: Authorized administration
status: Target administrative workflow. Existing source provides config/stats endpoints; UI, suspension and log-view actions and policy enforcement remain planned.

title: Breed eligible parents and claim one offspring
trace: WF-08; FR-18, FR-4, FR-1; FR-11 lock interaction
status: Target based on the existing breeding design and newly confirmed scope. Recipe values, slot capacity, cancellation and offline/server authority details are pending; no runtime completion is claimed.

title: Account eligibility
status: Target lifecycle. Administrative suspension and policy checks are planned. Session expiry and daily play limits are separate session conditions; reinstatement policy is open.

title: Local and cloud save synchronization
status: Target model. Conflict uses the registered newer-server reload policy; UI/data reconciliation details and tradable-asset integration remain open.

title: Biome structure and usable habitat
status: Document-level target model. Occupancy and production eligibility are separate data; damage/restore behavior is type-specific.

title: Creature ownership and contribution
status: Target contribution lifecycle; hunger, sickness, recovery and environmental flags coexist. Placement requires the separate ownership/use guards in STATE-11. Returned cards must preserve individual data, which is not established by current CardData-only return code.

title: Craft job lifecycle
status: Target model. CompletedHolding is a proposed safe representation for undelivered output, not an approved UI/full-storage rule. Cancellation/refund policy is intentionally absent.

title: Market listing lifecycle
status: States and expiry worker are present in the resource-market source. Resource escrow and identified-creature transfer describe the target; server ownership/locks and creature price validation remain unverified implementation work.

title: Inbox handling and acknowledgement
status: Target delivery lifecycle. The durable receipt must survive the agreed restore/multi-device scenarios; local apply-before-ack alone does not prove this.

title: Incident lifecycle and persistent biome damage
status: Source-informed game model. Incident completion and burned-tile recovery are separate lifecycles. Manual-pause integration remains a source-audit gap.

title: Wild encounter and taming attempt
status: Target encounter lifecycle informed by current rhythm flow. Failure/cancellation retains the encounter; session resonance is not permanent Harmony.

title: Breeding job, parent release and offspring claim
status: Target lifecycle. Completion releases parents; claim creates one distinct Rank I offspring. No queue, cancellation or refund transition is inferred before those rules are approved.

title: Creature ownership and incompatible-use locks
status: Target lifecycle from one account perspective. Care flags coexist with use states. Owner transfer keeps the same individual ID; the buyer receives that individual, not a newly minted species card. Authoritative lock storage is pending design.
